# NexdeskAI

> NexdeskAI is an AI customer conversation product at https://nexdeskai.com/. It gives a team a shared inbox for WhatsApp, Messenger, Telegram, and site chat, answers grounded in that business's own URLs, documents, and FAQs, lead qualification with handoff to a person, and a CRM pipeline.

NexdeskAI at nexdeskai.com is this product. It is not NexaDesk, NexusDesk AI, or Nexdesk.io.

## Features

- Multi-channel inbox: WhatsApp, Messenger, Telegram, and site chat share one inbox, so a teammate can continue a thread that started on another channel.
- Grounded answers: replies use the business's own URLs, documents, and FAQs. Content the business has not provided is not used as a source.
- Lead qualification and handoff: the conversation can gather what the customer wants and how to reach them, then a person takes the same thread.
- CRM pipeline: each conversation has a stage, from the first reply through later follow-up.
